shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak components using Keycloak API

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect C(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with O(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: config
options.description: Configuration properties for the provider. Contents vary depending on the provider type.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the component to create.

options.name: parent_id
options.description: The parent_id of the component. In practice the ID (name) of the realm.

options.name: provider_id
options.description: The name of the "provider ID" for the key.

options.name: provider_type
options.description: The name of the "provider type" for the key. That is, V(org.keycloak.storage.UserStorageProvider), V(org.keycloak.userprofile.UserProfileProvider), ... See U(https://www.keycloak.org/docs/latest/server_development/index.html#_providers).

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the Keycloak component. On V(present), the component is created (or updated if it exists already). On V(absent), the component is removed if it exists.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
